# Fireworks Provider

Manage Fireworks AI resources: GPU inference deployments and datasets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fireworks = {
      source = "amrutp24/fireworks"
    }
  }
}

provider "fireworks" {
  # api_key and account_id can also come from FIREWORKS_API_KEY
  # and FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID environment variables.
  account_id = "my-account"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Fireworks account ID. Can also be set via the FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID environment variable.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Fireworks API key. Can also be set via the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.fireworks.ai. Mainly for testing.
